01 / Against the script

Astrology is a mirror, not a muzzle.

Most readings hand you a personality sticker. You are told you are intense, nurturing, analytical — then sent back into the same old room.

I am more interested in what the chart makes difficult to ignore: the desire beneath the performance, the power you keep lending away, the contradiction that might become a choice.

Not prediction. Not diagnosis. A practice of noticing.
